title: アウトロー・アゲイン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time has passed since Vodka started searching for her true goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unlike Daiwa Scarlet, Vodka enjoys spontaneous action more than steadily working toward something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka worries that her childlike disposition will never allow her to defeat strong opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I offer encouragement, telling her that she should focus on what she finds cool.
